authorization: User requested merged ghost videos of the different variations starting from the same seed and state.
scope: AP-CEM versus matched final-goal CEM in each of the four current AP reproduction environments.
selection: First AP-CEM success and first AP-CEM failure by original query ordinal within each complete 128-query environment cohort; use the same original query for the counterpart planner.
pair_checks: same original identity and environment seed
same initial physical state and raw render hash
same fixed goal and goal image hash

presentation.main_view: 50/50 alpha blend of the two original decoded observation crops; no guessed segmentation or image-plane projection.
presentation.trajectory_panel: Color-coded saved native-coordinate paths including the actual stopping state; Reacher is joint space and Cube is XYZ.
presentation.action_panel: Last recorded executed action with its index, displayed on common per-channel scales; no action is implied at reset or after stop.
presentation.reference_views: Small separate AP, final-goal CEM and fixed-goal images.
presentation.timeline: Synchronize by executed-action number using recorded frame_steps; include the final true stopping action in the timeline.
presentation.stopped_arms: Hold the last available original observation and label the stopping action and last observed action explicitly.
presentation.interpolation: Do not synthesize intermediate simulator images or pretend the final saved observation is a terminal render.

provenance: Bind each derived output hash to both original MP4s, native case records and full saved trajectories, their pinned run revisions/manifests, generator hash, and pairing checks.
rental_authority: No new rental, time extension or scientific budget. Existing manual shutdown rules remain.
